Name: Pelican Neighbors
Author: Kidoku
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Pelican Neighbors[/b] is a realism-focused expansion mod for Stardew Valley designed to make your relationships with the local townsfolk feel truly organic and dynamic. Instead of just giving gifts to raise friendship, this mod introduces a reciprocal "give-and-take" system. Your neighbors will now dynamically interact with you, requesting your assistance in their daily lives and actively looking for ways to return the favor, creating a much more immersive and realistic community experience.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API) if you haven't already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and extract the contents of the[/color]

[code].zip[/code][color=#D4D4D8]file.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Copy the extracted[/color]

[code]PelicanNeighbors[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder and paste it into your Stardew Valley[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game using[/color]

[code]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/code][color=#D4D4D8]and enjoy![/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Reciprocal Favor System:[/b] Neighbors will randomly reach out to ask for your help. Assisting them isn't just for show—they will actively find ways to repay your kindness![/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Favor Credits:[/b] Earn [b]Favor Credits[/b] by helping the townsfolk. You can accumulate these points over time and spend them whenever you need to request favors from the neighbors in return.
- [i]You can receive gifts from villagers, ask them to clean up your farm, have them water your crops, or even borrow money from them (but don't forget to pay them back)!![/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Local Store Discounts:[/b] As you reach higher relationship and Favor milestones with the community, you will unlock exclusive discounts at various Pelican Town shops.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multi-language Support:[/b] Full localization support included (with default English and Vietnamese language files out of the box).[/color]

[b]How to use:[/b][/*]
[*]H (Stand next to a villager)**: Interact and request/give favors.[/*]
[*]N: Open the mod Menu.
[i](Configurable: You can change these hotkeys using mods like Generic Mod Config Menu).
[/i]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley[/b]: Make sure your game is updated to the latest version (v1.6+ recommended) to ensure full compatibility.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/b]: The essential tool required to run this mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]A massive, warm thank you to everyone who has downloaded, played, or planned to support this mod! [/i][/size]
